args.title: Bellwether: Retail Returns Logistics (2026) – Summary
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have reached 24%.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by about a fifth.
- Companion piece: reselling returned items within 10 days keeps most of the margin.

Sources: https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns ; https://insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion
